|description = {{Description|decoration}} }} The '''S. Pine''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|500}}, or be purchased from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]] for {{Price|500}}. It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}. Players who select a [[Farm Maps|Forest farm map]] during character creation will have one inside their house when the game begins. ==History== {{History|1.1|Introduced.}} {{History|1.5|Decor can be placed outside.
